cohort: 125 pregnant women with varying degrees of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) treated at a single hospital between 2016 and 2023.
finding: The severity of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is significantly correlated with worse cardiac function and an increased incidence of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section, particularly under intraspinal anesthesia, was the predominant and recommended mode of birth, especially in cases of severe PAH or sudden cardiac deterioration.
